svg.text: Fifteen rooms. raven is the documented Arden crow. New rows cover needs the first nine did not. Hexes are ours; moods after Color Hunt.
Codename for the Arden crow. Documented colours only.
Violet against yellow-green. Plaster wall, one theatrical cushion.
Sea against fired clay. Cool structure, one warm object.
Near-black architecture. One mineral green, no second neon.
Navy structure, one lacquered orange chair.
After Color Hunt sunsets: warmth without a traffic-light red.
After Color Hunt hot pink: one fuchsia object, not a neon field.
Earth board: cultivated green, one fired-clay pot.
Cold, not tiffany. A pale blue claim on a stone wall.
After Color Hunt gold boards. One brass object, not a yellow dashboard.
Coffee browns for a long page. Cognac is the only claim.
Pastel spring. Quiet enough to read, pink enough to be remembered.
The wall is the dark. Text and sofa are the light. One candle accent.
Aged paper and a dusty rose. History, not cabaret.
Deeper than veranda, colder than raven. One signal blue.
